headline: HuyenBao v11.50 — UX fixes + Power intro + NPC reactions + Brand customization
summary: UX + FEATURE PASS. Popups now close with Esc and click-outside (EditProfile, GigsPopup, MoreInfo, TravelSection, BizOffer, BrandEditor, WhatsNew). Cash display bigger + glowing gold chip. Toast longer (4.5-12s) + pulsing glow ring + raised z-index above modals. Power tab finally has a 'What is Power?' intro card explaining the 5 tiers + 4 influence sources + 3 things you can do. AI events now auto-post as rumors to the social feed, with NPC friends + rivals reacting based on friendship level (sentiment-colored comments). Franchise gets a clear economics explainer card (upfront fee = 1.8× branch value, 10% ongoing royalty). New brand customization: rename + re-logo each biz chain you own.
features: FIX: Esc-to-close on all dismissible popups (EditProfile, GigsPopup, MoreInfo, TravelSection, BizOffer, BrandEditor, WhatsNew)
FIX: click-outside already worked on modal-overlay popups; verified + cleaned up handlers
ENHANCE: cash display in PinZone upgraded from pchip → cash-chip class (1.02rem font, gold border, soft glow, low-cash warning turns red)
ENHANCE: toast duration raised 3.5-8s → 4.5-12s; pulsing accent-color glow ring; z-index 200 → 300 (above modals); bigger font + padding
NEW: Power tab intro card — 'What is Power?' elevator pitch + 4 influence sources (charity/club/board/media) + 5-tier ladder + 3 things you can do (advocacy/transparency/election) + charity tip
NEW: AI events auto-post to social feed as rumor headlines (kind-aware: 📈 luck / 📉 badluck / 🔄 lifestage / 📰 story)
NEW: NPC reactions on AI-event posts — friends (friendship > 50) comment supportive (green), rivals (< 0) snark (red), neutral acks (muted)
NEW: generateNpcReactions() picks up to 3 commenters from s.relations, one per sentiment bucket
NEW: Post.reactions field on the social post shape for rendering NPC comments under the post
NEW: Franchise explainer card in BizTab — clear economics (1.8× upfront, 10% royalty) + when-to-use tip
NEW: Brand customization — setBizBrand() + bizBrandOf() engine helpers; brands map on GameState
NEW: BrandEditorModal — name input + emoji logo input + 24 suggested emojis; per-biz; reset-to-default option
NEW: Brand displays on the biz row (logo + custom name + ★ tag), survives save migration
